name: HatchPattern
summary: An HatchPattern object represents an hatch pattern in the model.

methods.name: clear_fill_pattern
methods.remarks: The #clear_fill_pattern method removes the .pat line-pattern definition from the Sketchup::HatchPattern.

methods.name: clear_fill_texture
methods.summary: The #clear_fill_texture method removes the texture fill from the Sketchup::HatchPattern.
methods.remarks: The #clear_fill_texture method removes the texture fill from the Sketchup::HatchPattern.

methods.name: fill_pattern_file_name
methods.summary: The #fill_pattern_file_name method retrieves the file path the .
methods.remarks: The #fill_pattern_file_name method retrieves the file path the .pat line-pattern definition was loaded from.

methods.name: fill_texture_file_name
methods.summary: The #fill_texture_file_name method retrieves the file path the fill texture image was loaded from.
methods.remarks: The #fill_texture_file_name method retrieves the file path the fill texture image was loaded from.

methods.name: fill_texture_image
methods.summary: The #fill_texture_image method retrieves the fill texture image of the Sketchup::HatchPattern, or nil if the pattern has no texture fill.
methods.remarks: The #fill_texture_image method retrieves the fill texture image of the Sketchup::HatchPattern, or nil if the pattern has no texture fill.

methods.name: save_fill_pattern_to_file
methods.remarks: The #save_fill_pattern_to_file method writes the .pat line-pattern definition to a file. This writes only the pattern definition, not the whole hatch pattern; use #write for the latter.

params.name: file_name
params.doc: the path to write the .pat file to.

throws.when: if the pattern has no .pat definition or the file could not be written.

methods.name: set_fill_pattern_from_file
methods.remarks: Note: A .pat file may hold more than one pattern definition. Only the first definition in The #set_fill_pattern_from_file method loads a .pat line-pattern definition from a file. the file is loaded; any others are ignored.

params.name: file_name
params.doc: the path to the .pat file to load.

throws.when: if the .pat file could not be loaded.

methods.name: set_fill_texture_image_and_file_name
methods.summary: The #set_fill_texture_image_and_file_name method sets the fill texture image and the file path it came from together, as a unit.
methods.remarks: The #set_fill_texture_image_and_file_name method sets the fill texture image and the file path it came from together, as a unit.

params.name: file_name
params.doc: the file path the texture was loaded from.

throws.when: if image is not a ImageRep or does not contain valid image data.

methods.name: set_uv_scale
methods.summary: The #set_uv_scale method sets the UV scale of the Sketchup::HatchPattern.
methods.remarks: The #set_uv_scale method sets the UV scale of the Sketchup::HatchPattern. Both values must be positive. The scale is a factor applied to the pattern’s repeat; it is not a percentage.

throws.when: if either scale is not a positive value.

methods.name: thumbnail_image
methods.summary: The #thumbnail_image method retrieves the cached preview image of the Sketchup::HatchPattern.
methods.remarks: The #thumbnail_image method retrieves the cached preview image of the Sketchup::HatchPattern.

methods.name: uv_scale
methods.summary: The #uv_scale method retrieves the UV scale of the Sketchup::HatchPattern as a u and v pair.
methods.remarks: The #uv_scale method retrieves the UV scale of the Sketchup::HatchPattern as a u and v pair. The scale is a positive factor applied to the pattern’s repeat; it is not a percentage.

returns.doc: the u and v scale factors

methods.name: write
methods.summary: Writes the hatch pattern to file as a .
methods.remarks: Writes the hatch pattern to file as a .skh file.

properties.name: fill_color
properties.summary: The #fill_color method retrieves the solid fill color of the Sketchup::HatchPattern.
properties.remarks: The #fill_color method retrieves the solid fill color of the Sketchup::HatchPattern.

properties.name: name
properties.summary: The #name method retrieves the name of the Sketchup::HatchPattern.
properties.remarks: The #name method retrieves the name of the Sketchup::HatchPattern.

properties.name: rotation_angle
properties.summary: The #rotation_angle method retrieves the rotation angle applied to the Sketchup::HatchPattern, in degrees.
properties.remarks: The #rotation_angle method retrieves the rotation angle applied to the Sketchup::HatchPattern, in degrees.
